profile.summary: A classic science fiction short story by Isaac Asimov, first published in 1956. It follows humanity across immense stretches of time, repeatedly asking an ever-evolving supercomputer how the net entropy of the universe can be decreased. The story spans from a casual bet in 2061 to the far future of the cosmos, ending with its famous twist.
